A busy round ahead, a few tips
The subject is handler training
Travelers' notice for companion animals

Traveling with a pet should be calm, orderly, and safe. Please keep your carrier closed when asked, follow staff directions, and allow extra patience at the check-in point.

For smooth handling, make sure collars, leads, and paperwork are ready before you reach the desk. <<FACT F014>> Our team will guide you through each step, and every animal receives patient attention from trained staff. Keep your pet close and speak softly so the journey stays steady for everyone.

If you are using the pet lounge, listen for the posted guidance and stay with your animal until you are called onward. <<FACT F004>> <<FACT F021>> Aurelia Skyways values careful travel, and we ask travelers to treat shared spaces with the same care.

For help with any part of your trip, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
